div.head: Northu 39
div.ab: Gif preost ordol misfadige, gebete þæt.
Gif preost ordol misfadige, gebete þæt.
Wenn ein Priester ein Ordal falsch leitet, büsse er das.
If a priest wrongly conducts an ordeal, let him atone for it.
If a priest conducts the ordeal wrongly, he is to compensate for it.
If a priest errs while carrying out an ordeal, he is to atone for that.
div.note: Liebermann compares V Atr 18 and VI Atr 25.
